description: Cross-token capital flow analysis. Shows which fan tokens are gaining vs losing volume relative to their recent average. Detects rotation: when whales exit one token, where does the capital go?

hours.description: Compare last N hours vs prior period. Default: 24.

limit.description: Rows returned: the strongest movers by |relative_change_pct| (inflows and outflows both kept). Default 20; counts always cover the whole universe.

min_volume_usd.description: Hide dust: tokens whose current AND prior rolling-24h volume are both below this. Default $1,000; pass 0 for everything.

name: tokenintel_capital_rotation
